archive1.description: Path to the first zip archive or directory

archive2.description: Path to the second zip archive or directory

consistency_check.description: If true, enable -C flag to check archive consistency

ignore_case.description: If true, enable -i flag to ignore case distinctions in names

paranoid.description: If true, enable -p flag for paranoid checks of metadata

summary.description: If true, enable -s flag to print summary of differences

compare_timestamps.description: If true, enable -T flag to compare entry timestamps

test_checksums.description: If true, enable -t flag to test contents against checksums

quiet.description: If true, enable -q flag for quiet mode

verbose.description: If true, enable -v flag for verbose output
